resolvedFindings.fix: Save state now carries levelRevision. First load from levelRevision<5 returns to the same floor lantern, preserves resources and control flags, and marks revision5. Same-revision loads preserve position.
resolvedFindings.evidence: 3962 actual old-v4 action states reloaded to safe lantern without scalar or key/choice/control differences. A real revision5 state at floor8 open water position4,14 reloaded byte-for-byte unchanged.

limits: No browser, pixel-fidelity, alpha-fringe appearance, performance, audio or mobile interaction acceptance is claimed here.
